## Purpose and package topology
SvelteKit is a JavaScript/TypeScript web framework monorepo. Its core package builds and runs Svelte applications with file-based routing, SSR/CSR, endpoints, forms, prerendering, and deployment adapters. Workspace packages also provide image processing and library packaging.
- `packages/kit`
- `packages/enhanced-img`
- `packages/package`

## Primary entry points
The user-facing framework CLI and package entry are in the core package; Vite integration is the build/dev boundary. Public framework APIs are separated from implementation internals.
- `packages/kit/src/cli.js`
- `packages/kit/svelte-kit.js`
- `packages/kit/src/exports/index.js`
- `packages/kit/src/exports/vite/index.js`

## Project analysis and generated application metadata
The sync stage reads an application’s route filesystem, validates route conflicts and parameters, then writes generated manifests, TypeScript configuration/types, environment modules, and server/client entry artifacts. This is the key boundary between user source files and generated `.svelte-kit` build inputs.
- `packages/kit/src/core/sync/sync.js`
- `packages/kit/src/core/sync/create_manifest_data/index.js`
- `packages/kit/src/core/sync/write_server.js`
- `packages/kit/src/core/sync/write_client_manifest.js`

## Build, prerender, and adaptation pipeline
Vite plugins and build orchestration compile client/server bundles, statically analyze modules, and build service workers/remote-function artifacts. Postbuild analysis can crawl and prerender routes. The adapter interface then receives build output through a builder abstraction and emits target-platform deployment artifacts.
- `packages/kit/src/exports/vite/build/index.js`
- `packages/kit/src/core/postbuild/prerender.js`
- `packages/kit/src/core/adapt/builder.js`
- `packages/kit/src/core/adapt/index.js`

## Server request execution
A platform adapter converts an incoming request into Kit’s server runtime. The central responder applies hooks/routing, dispatches endpoints or page actions, executes server loads, renders SSR output, and handles cookies, CSRF, errors, redirects, headers, and streaming. This layer uses Web-standard Request/Response semantics while adapters isolate platform specifics.
- `packages/kit/src/runtime/server/respond.js`
- `packages/kit/src/runtime/server/endpoint.js`
- `packages/kit/src/runtime/server/page/index.js`
- `packages/kit/src/runtime/server/page/actions.js`

## Browser runtime and data synchronization
The client entry hydrates rendered pages and owns in-app navigation, preloading, fetch/data payload handling, scroll/focus restoration, snapshots, and page state. Remote functions provide client proxies and caches for server-defined query, command, form, and live-query operations; transport/serialization is shared across the server-client boundary.
- `packages/kit/src/runtime/client/client.js`
- `packages/kit/src/runtime/client/fetcher.js`
- `packages/kit/src/runtime/client/remote-functions/index.js`
- `packages/kit/src/runtime/app/internal/transport.js`

## Deployment and ecosystem boundaries
Adapters package the same generated server/client output for Node, Bun, Cloudflare Workers/Pages, Netlify, Vercel, or static hosting; auto-selection delegates to installed platform adapters. Supported material runtimes/infrastructure are Node.js, Bun, Cloudflare, Netlify, Vercel, and static hosts. Vite is the principal build-system dependency, while optional telemetry integrates OpenTelemetry.
- `packages/adapter-node/src/index.js`
- `packages/adapter-bun/src/handler.js`
- `packages/adapter-cloudflare/files/worker.js`
- `packages/adapter-auto/index.js`
